HAD FIXED.example: A: 「Did you experience any network issues during the virtual meeting?」 B: 「No, the technician had fixed the server problem before the conference call started.」

WOULD BE WALKING.example: A: 「The classical art section is so crowded today.」 B: 「If they had expanded the gallery space, visitors would be walking more comfortably right now.」

HAD EXCEEDED.example: A: 「What did the auditor say about our waste management?」 B: 「She noted that we had exceeded our recycling targets for three consecutive years.」

HAD ISSUED.example: A: 「Did the manager approve your request to work from abroad?」 B: 「Yes, he confirmed that the HR department had issued the updated telecommuting policy last month.」

HAD BURST.example: A: 「Why is the west wing of the museum closed?」 B: 「The director announced that a pipe had burst during the night, causing minor water damage to the floor.」

WOULD HAVE BEEN PREVENTED.example: Policy Review: The coastal defense budget was cut last year due to political disagreements. A climate scientist warned that if the government had allocated sufficient funds, the severe flooding in the southern districts would have been prevented. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?

HAD REPORTED.example: Research Brief: A recent academic study explored the mental health of telecommuters. The lead researcher stated that employees who lacked social interaction had reported higher levels of anxiety during the initial phase of the lockdown. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?

TO REDUCE OR LESSEN.example: The concept of to reduce or lessen is fundamental in this context.
TO REDUCE OR LESSEN.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「mitigate」的核心意涵。

AS OF.example: The new policy will take effect as of next month.
AS OF.exampleZh: as of = 自…起生效，常用於公告政策或價格的生效日期。

HAD I LEFT.example: Hardly had i left the office when it started pouring rain outside.
HAD I LEFT.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：否定副詞 Hardly 置於句首時需倒裝，且搭配過去完成式表示「一...就...」，故選 had I left。

HAD NOTICED.example: She admitted she had noticed the warning signs prior to the system crash, but had chosen to ignore them.
HAD NOTICED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：在系統崩潰（the system crash）之前就已經注意到警告標誌，必須使用過去完成式 had noticed。

HAD BEEN ADMINISTERED.example: The new cognitive tests had been administered to the students before the researchers realized there was a flaw in the design.
HAD BEEN ADMINISTERED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。

HAD MANIPULATED.example: The politician firmly denied that he had manipulated the public data to win the re-election.
HAD MANIPULATED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。

HAD INTERVIEWED.example: A: 「Did you manage to secure a credible source for the article?」 B: 「Yes, but only after I had interviewed three other anonymous informants.」
HAD INTERVIEWED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。

WOULD INCREASE.example: A: 「Will the residential density increase next year?」 B: 「The journalist asked the planner if the residential density would increase the following year.」
WOULD INCREASE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。

HAD PURCHASED.example: A: "Did you manage to buy that vintage leather jacket online?" B: "No, someone else had purchased it before I even reached the checkout page."

HAD NOT DELETED.example: Wellness Blog: Taking a digital detox can reset your mental state. Looking back at her experience, Jane realized that if she had not deleted the controversial app, she would not have regained her peace of mind so quickly. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?
HAD NOT DELETED.exampleZh: 本題測驗與過去事實相反的假設語氣。

HAD CAUSED.meaning: 本題測驗間接引語時態
HAD CAUSED.example: A: "Why is Sarah completely offline this week?" B: "She mentioned that the flood of negative comments had caused her too much stress lately."
HAD CAUSED.exampleZh: 本題測驗間接引語時態。

WOULD FIX.example: The software developer explained to the committee that the massive new patch would fix several critical bugs in the system.
WOULD FIX.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主要動詞 explained 為過去式，故名詞子句中的 will fix 須配合時態退化為 would fix。

HAD TESTED.example: The principal formally announced that the school had tested a cutting-edge virtual reality program the previous semester.
HAD TESTED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：由 the previous semester 可知原本是過去式，在間接引語中退化為過去完成式。

INTERNAL POLITICAL CORRUPTION.example: The concept of internal political corruption is fundamental in this context.
INTERNAL POLITICAL CORRUPTION.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「繁體中文解說」的核心意涵。

MIGHT BE.example: The cybersecurity official urgently warned the committee that the autonomous vehicle's software might be highly vulnerable to remote hacking.
MIGHT BE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主要子句動詞 warned 為過去式，附屬子句的助動詞 may 須改為過去式 might。

WOULD ADOPT.example: The head chef firmly promised the manager that his kitchen would adopt a strict zero-waste policy by the following year.
WOULD ADOPT.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：承諾未來的動作，原本的 will adopt 配合 promised 轉為過去未來式 would adopt。

HAD INVESTED.example: The pharmaceutical company had invested billions in the neural implant project before they finally realized the technology was essentially flawed.

WOULD HAVE COLLAPSED.example: But for the financial support from UNESCO, the ancient city walls would have collapsed completely into ruin during the devastating earthquake last decade.

HAD GLOSSED.example: During the press conference, the CEO firmly denied that the management had glossed intentionally over the gender pay gap report earlier that year.

HAD BEGUN.example: A: "Was the local community consulted about the new resort construction?" B: "No, the developers had begun the land clearance before the villagers even knew about the project."

HAD ENFORCED.example: Environmental Digest: The ice caps are melting at an unprecedented rate. A leading climatologist warned that if global leaders had enforced stricter carbon emission laws a decade ago, we would not be facing such extreme coastal erosion today. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?

HAD SAMPLED.example: The copyright lawyer explained to the jury that the defendant had sampled the melody from an obscure 1980s pop song without permission.

HAD RESTRICTED.example: Global Summit: The debate over ocean conservation lasted for days. A representative from the island nation stressed that if major powers had restricted their plastic waste exports earlier, marine ecosystems would not be in such a critical state today. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?

HAD UNDERESTIMATED.example: HR Newsletter: The shift to telecommuting has transformed our company culture. During the recent town hall meeting, the CEO admitted that she had underestimated the benefits of flexible working hours before the pandemic forced the organization to adapt. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?

HAD IGNORED.example: Flight Compensation: Consumer rights groups are fighting for better protection against sudden flight cancellations. During the hearing, a lawyer stated that the airline had ignored the mechanical issues for weeks before the engine finally failed mid-flight. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?

DID THEY MEET.meaning: Not only 放句首要倒裝
DID THEY MEET.example: Not only did they meet the target, but they also exceeded it.
DID THEY MEET.exampleZh: Not only 放句首要倒裝：助動詞 did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

WOULD HAVE FIXED.example: Had we known about the issue, we would have fixed it earlier.
WOULD HAVE FIXED.exampleZh: Had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 是省略 if 的過去假設，主要子句用 would have + 過去分詞。

DO WE SEE.example: Rarely do we see such strong results.
DO WE SEE.exampleZh: 否定副詞 Rarely 放句首要倒裝：Rarely do we see...。

WOULD HAVE ACTED.example: Had I known, I would have acted differently.
WOULD HAVE ACTED.exampleZh: Had + p.p. 是與過去相反的假設，主要子句用 would have + p.p.。

HAVING ANALYZED.example: having analyzed the data, we revised the plan.
HAVING ANALYZED.exampleZh: Having + p.p. 表示先完成的動作，主詞一致（我們分析了資料）。

SHOULD YOU.meaning: 否定副詞片語放句首要倒裝
SHOULD YOU.example: Under no circumstances should you leave the door unlocked.
SHOULD YOU.exampleZh: 否定副詞片語放句首要倒裝：Under no circumstances should you...。

IN UNDER.example: The project came in under budget, saving us money.
IN UNDER.exampleZh: come in under budget：結算低於預算。

DID THE BOARD RECOGNISE.example: Only after the audit did the board recognise the scale of the discrepancy.
DID THE BOARD RECOGNISE.exampleZh: Only after 置於句首時，主要子句需助動詞倒裝：did＋主詞＋原形動詞。

HAVING BEEN PLANNED.example: having been planned in considerable detail, the itinerary left little room for spontaneous changes.
HAVING BEEN PLANNED.exampleZh: itinerary 是被規劃的對象，需被動 Having been planned。

HAD THE SHOP ANNOUNCED.example: No sooner had the shop announced the revised opening hours than customers began asking for clarification.
HAD THE SHOP ANNOUNCED.exampleZh: No sooner 置首，過去完成式倒裝為 had＋主詞＋過去分詞，並與 than 搭配。

DID OFFICIALS DISCLOSE.example: Not until residents challenged the figures did officials disclose the assumptions underlying the forecast.
DID OFFICIALS DISCLOSE.exampleZh: Not until 置首，主要子句助動詞倒裝為 did officials disclose。

HAVING CONSIDERED.example: having considered only the direct costs, the planners omitted the expense of relocating residents.
HAVING CONSIDERED.exampleZh: planners 是考量成本的人，Having considered 表先前已完成的主動動作，與後面的主詞一致。

DID THE LEARNERS REALISE.example: Little did the learners realise how much the familiar examples were guiding their answers.
DID THE LEARNERS REALISE.exampleZh: Little 置首表否定意味，助動詞倒裝用 did the learners realise。

DOES THE READER APPRECIATE.example: Only on a second reading does the reader appreciate the significance of the apparently casual remark.
DOES THE READER APPRECIATE.exampleZh: Only 引導限制語置首，主要子句用助動詞倒裝。

DID THE MEMBERS ACKNOWLEDGE.example: Only when the allocation became public did the members acknowledge the conflict of interest.
DID THE MEMBERS ACKNOWLEDGE.exampleZh: Only when 置首，主要子句倒裝為 did the members acknowledge。

WOULD HAVE ADJUSTED.example: Had she been told about the change, she would have adjusted her plans accordingly.
WOULD HAVE ADJUSTED.exampleZh: 過去反事實條件 Had...been told 對應 would have＋過去分詞。

DID THE STEWARD ADMIT.example: Only when the villagers challenged the seal did the steward admit that the letter had no recognised authority.
DID THE STEWARD ADMIT.exampleZh: Only when 置首引發主句倒裝。

ARRIVE WARM.example: The concept of arrive warm is fundamental in this context.
ARRIVE WARM.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「arrive warm」的核心意涵。

THE CLEARER.example: The more closely we observed the markings, the clearer it became that the two birds were different.
THE CLEARER.exampleZh: the more ..., the clearer ... 表相關程度變化。

MATCHED WERE THE TEAMS.example: So evenly matched were the teams that no side led by more than a point.
MATCHED WERE THE TEAMS.exampleZh: So evenly matched were the teams that ... 程度詞前置倒裝。

BEING TREATED.example: He insisted on being treated as a beginner, despite his previous experience.

BE RETAINED.example: The editor requested that the qualification be retained in the headline.
BE RETAINED.exampleZh: request that 後用原形虛擬式。

HAVING TAKEN.example: The reporter denied having taken the quotation out of context.

THE LESS.example: The sooner we agree on priorities, the less time we will waste debating individual purchases.
THE LESS.exampleZh: the sooner ..., the less ... 對應程度變化，time 不可數。

MIGHT HAVE AVOIDED.example: Had the availability survey been circulated earlier, we might have avoided the clash.
MIGHT HAVE AVOIDED.exampleZh: 過去反事實條件倒裝，主句 might have avoided。

TO HAVE BEEN PAINTED.example: The portrait is thought to have been painted before the family moved away.
TO HAVE BEEN PAINTED.exampleZh: is thought to have been painted 表據信先前被繪成。

DOES THE SIGN BECOME.example: Not until visitors reach the junction does the sign become visible.
DOES THE SIGN BECOME.exampleZh: Not until 前置引主句倒裝，does 後用 become。

THE MORE STRIKING.example: The more restrained the opening, the more striking the later outburst becomes.
THE MORE STRIKING.exampleZh: the more ..., the more ... 表程度連動。

DID WE REALISE.example: Only after the wind dropped did we realise how far the bell could be heard.
DID WE REALISE.exampleZh: Only after 前置，主句did倒裝接realise原形。

TO PROVE.example: Were the alternative to prove impractical, we would retain the current arrangement.
TO PROVE.exampleZh: Were…to prove為假設倒裝，相當於If the alternative were to prove…。

WOULD BE REVIEWED.example: We agreed to the trial on the understanding that its results would be reviewed before any permanent change was made.
WOULD BE REVIEWED.exampleZh: 過去agree後的未來被動為would be reviewed，review需過去分詞。

WOULD PROCEED.example: Were the board to approve the restructuring tomorrow, implementation would proceed across six distinct phases.
WOULD PROCEED.exampleZh: Were the board to approve 為假設語氣倒裝，主句配 would proceed。

NOT ABANDONED.example: Had the poet not abandoned the archaic sonnet structure, the emotional intimacy would have been lost.
NOT ABANDONED.exampleZh: Had the poet not abandoned 否定虛擬假設倒裝句型。

HAD OBSERVERS WITNESSED.example: Seldom had observers witnessed such an unyielding consensus among rival political factions.
HAD OBSERVERS WITNESSED.exampleZh: 否定副詞 Seldom 置於句首引導部分倒裝，助動詞 had 須置於主詞 observers 之前。

DID THE BOARD REALIZE.example: Not until the final audit was published did the board realize the full extent of the fiscal embezzlement.
DID THE BOARD REALIZE.exampleZh: Not until... 引導時間子句置於句首時，主要子句須採用倒裝語序 did the board realize。

CAN RESEARCHERS.example: Only by subjecting empirical hypotheses to rigorous refutation can researchers ensure genuine scientific advancement.
CAN RESEARCHERS.exampleZh: Only by + 介系詞片語置於句首時，主要子句須倒裝為情態助動詞 can + 主詞 researchers。

DID THE EXECUTIVES ANTICIPATE.example: Little did the executives anticipate that the contractual caveat would eventually jeopardize their corporate sovereignty.
DID THE EXECUTIVES ANTICIPATE.exampleZh: 否定副詞 Little 置於句首表示「完全沒料到」，助動詞 did 須前置倒裝。

BE INVESTED.example: It is imperative that the envoy be invested with full plenipotentiary authority during bilateral negotiations.
BE INVESTED.exampleZh: imperative that 子句須使用原形動詞虛擬式 be invested（省略 should）。

WOULD NOT BE.example: Had the civil engineers reinforced the levee system, the coastal basin would not be submerged today.
WOULD NOT BE.exampleZh: 過去完成式假設對應現在結果（錯綜條件句），主要子句使用 would not be。

WOULD REMAIN.example: Were it not for international humanitarian corridors, thousands of stranded refugees would remain without potable water.
WOULD REMAIN.exampleZh: Were it not for... 表示「若非目前有…」，主要子句對應現在推測 would remain。

WOULD UNDERGO.meaning: were to 表未來純粹假設
WOULD UNDERGO.example: If the central bank were to hike rates abruptly, capital markets would undergo severe contraction.
WOULD UNDERGO.exampleZh: were to 表未來純粹假設，主要子句使用 would undergo。

ASPERSIONS.meaning: 惡意誹謗、詆毀…的名譽與可信度
ASPERSIONS.example: During the parliamentary inquiry, the defense counsel cast severe aspersions on the credibility of the whistleblower.
ASPERSIONS.exampleZh: cast aspersions on 為正式搭配，意為「惡意誹謗、詆毀…的名譽與可信度」。

TERMS.meaning: 正視、妥協並逐漸接受痛苦現實
TERMS.example: After decades of historical denial, the nation is finally coming to terms with its colonial transgressions.
TERMS.exampleZh: come to terms with 表示「正視、妥協並逐漸接受痛苦現實」。

SWAY.meaning: 對…擁有絕對主導統治地位
SWAY.example: For nearly half a century, the authoritarian dynasty held absolute sway over the peninsula commerce.
SWAY.exampleZh: hold sway over 為高級搭配，意為「對…擁有絕對主導統治地位」。

BLANK.example: When cross-examined about the secret offshore bank accounts, the witness drew a complete blank.
BLANK.exampleZh: draw a blank 為慣用語，意為「腦中一片空白、毫無頭緒或無法記起」。

CAN PLAINTIFFS.example: Only by exhaustively demonstrating procedural ultra vires can plaintiffs overturn the administrative decree.
CAN PLAINTIFFS.exampleZh: Only by... 倒裝引導情態動詞 can plaintiffs overturn。

HAVE WE SEEN.example: Seldom have we seen such a dramatic shift in consumer behavior.
HAVE WE SEEN.exampleZh: 否定副詞 Seldom 放句首要倒裝：have + 主詞 + 過去分詞。

HAVING ASSESSED.example: having assessed the potential risks, the team decided to postpone the launch.
HAVING ASSESSED.exampleZh: Having assessed 是完成式分詞構句，表示團隊先評估風險再決定延期。

HAVE REVIEWERS OBSERVED.example: Rarely have reviewers observed such a marked difference between the advertised and actual performance.
HAVE REVIEWERS OBSERVED.exampleZh: Rarely 置首，現在完成式助動詞提前，主詞 reviewers 在 have 與 observed 之間。

HAD BEEN AVAILABLE.meaning: 過去才發現先前一直可取得
HAD BEEN AVAILABLE.example: We need not have carried the heavy guidebook; a copy had been available at the centre all along.
HAD BEEN AVAILABLE.exampleZh: 過去才發現先前一直可取得，用 had been available。

COULD HAVE AVOIDED.meaning: 本來可避免已發生的攀爬
COULD HAVE AVOIDED.example: Had the closure been indicated at the first junction yesterday, we could have avoided the unnecessary climb we ended up making.
COULD HAVE AVOIDED.exampleZh: Had引導與過去事實相反的條件，主句could have avoided表示本來可避免已發生的攀爬。

COME.meaning: 無論發生何事、不管後果如何
COME.example: come what may, the research team remains committed to publishing their unedited empirical findings.
COME.exampleZh: Come what may 為固定倒裝讓步虛擬結構，意為「無論發生何事、不管後果如何」。

CHORD.example: The novelist poignant portrayal of exile struck a profound chord with thousands of displaced readers.
CHORD.exampleZh: strike a chord with 表示「在…心中引起強烈共鳴」。

LIP.meaning: 口惠而實不至、僅做表面文章
LIP.example: The corporate board paid mere lip service to environmental sustainability while expanding offshore drilling.
LIP.exampleZh: pay lip service to 表示「口惠而實不至、僅做表面文章」。

DID THEY KNOW.example: Little did they know that the decision would change everything.
DID THEY KNOW.exampleZh: 否定意味的 Little 放句首要倒裝：did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

DID THEY FIND.example: Only after the audit did they find the mistake.
DID THEY FIND.exampleZh: Only after... 放句首，主要子句倒裝：did they find。

WOULD HAVE.example: Were it not for your help, we would have failed.
WOULD HAVE.exampleZh: Were it not for... = If it were not for...。

DID WE LEARN.example: Not until the end did we learn the truth.
DID WE LEARN.exampleZh: Not until... 放句首，主要子句倒裝：did we learn。

WAS THE ASSUMPTION.example: So pervasive was the assumption that alternatives were scarcely discussed.
WAS THE ASSUMPTION.exampleZh: So＋形容詞置首的此倒裝結構為 So pervasive was the assumption that...。

MIGHT DIFFER.example: Were the same search conducted at night, its findings might differ substantially.
MIGHT DIFFER.exampleZh: Were ... conducted 是假設條件倒裝，主句用 might + 原形。

OF WHICH.example: The conclusion depends on a distinction, the stability of which the report never examines.
OF WHICH.exampleZh: the stability of which 為關係子句結構，which 指 distinction。

DID SHE ANTICIPATE.example: Little did she anticipate that her tentative remark would become the headline.
DID SHE ANTICIPATE.exampleZh: Little 前置表否定，引發 did + 主詞 + 原形倒裝。

NEVER HAVING BEEN.example: The letter is all the more revealing for never having been intended for publication.
NEVER HAVING BEEN.exampleZh: for 後動名詞，never having been intended 表先前未打算公開。

DOES THE LAYOUT PRESUME.example: So insistently does the layout presume familiarity that a newcomer’s confusion is made to look like a personal failing.
DOES THE LAYOUT PRESUME.exampleZh: So insistently 前置引 does 主詞原形倒裝。

TO DISCLOSE.example: The light seemed less to illuminate the walls than to disclose their accumulated shadows.
TO DISCLOSE.exampleZh: seemed less to X than to Y 平行不定詞結構。

HAVE ACQUIRED BY CHANCE.example: The remark betrays more knowledge than its speaker could reasonably have acquired by chance.
HAVE ACQUIRED BY CHANCE.exampleZh: could have acquired 表先前可能取得的知識。

TO FIND IN.example: The silence is an answer, though not necessarily the one the interviewer would prefer to find in it.
TO FIND IN.exampleZh: would prefer to find in it，it指silence。

LOUD AND POWERFUL.example: A stentorian voice is notably loud and powerful.
LOUD AND POWERFUL.exampleZh: stentorian形容洪亮有力，不直接評斷內容或態度。

DID THE HUM PERSIST.example: So insistently did the hum persist beneath the dialogue that the critic began to hear the room itself as a character.
DID THE HUM PERSIST.exampleZh: So加副詞置首，引起主句倒裝did the hum persist。

WOULD NOT HAVE BEEN.example: Had the pauses been merely accidental, their recurrence at precisely these moments would not have been so readily explicable.
WOULD NOT HAVE BEEN.exampleZh: 過去反事實條件Had…been搭配would not have been。

THOUGH IT MAY BE.example: The objection, persuasive though it may be in isolation, ignores the constraints under which the alternative would operate.
THOUGH IT MAY BE.exampleZh: 形容詞置首的讓步結構persuasive though it may be，承認局部說服力後提出限制。

MIGHT NOT HAVE SEEMED.meaning: 原先保證及撤回均為已發生的情節
MIGHT NOT HAVE SEEMED.example: Looking back on yesterday’s exchange, had the assurance been less categorical, its withdrawal minutes later might not have seemed quite so conspicuous at the time.
MIGHT NOT HAVE SEEMED.exampleZh: 原先保證及撤回均為已發生的情節，過去反事實結果用might not have seemed。

WOULD HAVE PASSED.example: Had the ombudsman not intervened ex officio, the systemic cover-up would have passed unnoticed by parliamentary overseers.
WOULD HAVE PASSED.exampleZh: Had ... not intervened 為過去假設倒裝，主句配 would have passed unnoticed。

WOULD HAVE METASTASIZED.example: Had the central bank not acted as lender of last resort, the liquidity crunch would have metastasized into systemic insolvency.
WOULD HAVE METASTASIZED.exampleZh: Had ... not acted ... would have metastasized 虛擬假設倒裝，表示惡化擴散。

WOULD BE WIDELY.example: Had the pre-modern cartographers not mapped the archipelago with such fidelity, modern territorial boundaries would be widely contested today.
WOULD BE WIDELY.exampleZh: 錯綜虛擬條件：過去測繪精確，避免了今日邊界廣泛產生爭端（would be widely contested today）。

FALL.example: Lest the tribunal neutrality fall into disrepute, all correspondence between judges and litigants was banned.
FALL.exampleZh: Lest... (should) fall 引導目的狀語從句，動詞使用原形虛擬式 fall 表示「唯恐、免得」。

WOULD NOT EXIST.example: If epistemological foundationalism had survived intact into the twenty-first century, cognitive linguistics would not exist in its present paradigm.
WOULD NOT EXIST.exampleZh: 錯綜虛擬：過去若基礎主義尚存，今日認知語言學便不會處於現存典範中。

CONSTRUABLE.example: construable it as you will, the diplomatic maneuver was a calculated act of brinkmanship.
CONSTRUABLE.exampleZh: Construe it as you will 為祈使虛擬句型，意為「隨你怎麼解讀，這都是經過算計的邊緣政策」。

VICTORY.meaning: 付出了慘重代價而得不償失的慘勝
VICTORY.example: The sovereign costly conquest of the border province proved to be a pyrrhic victory that exhausted the royal treasury.
VICTORY.exampleZh: a pyrrhic victory 指付出了慘重代價而得不償失的慘勝。

BLANCHE.example: The foreign minister was given carte blanche to negotiate the terms of the maritime demarcation.
BLANCHE.exampleZh: carte blanche 為法語借詞成語，意為「全權處置權、自由全權」。

PALE.meaning: 超越社會容忍底線、大逆不道
PALE.example: The diplomat racist tirade at the summit was widely condemned as utterly beyond the pale.
PALE.exampleZh: beyond the pale 為歷史典故成語，意為「超越社會容忍底線、大逆不道」。

LOOSE.example: To present such speculative hypotheses as established fact is to play fast and loose with scientific integrity.
LOOSE.exampleZh: play fast and loose with 表示「輕浮對待、對…不負責任、任意妄為」。

WOULD DEGENERATE.example: Were legal realism to supplant all formalist jurisprudence, judicial decisions would degenerate into pure politics.
WOULD DEGENERATE.exampleZh: Were... to supplant 虛擬倒裝，推論法律現實主義若徹底取代形式主義，司法判決將退化為純粹政治。

HAD SHE STEPPED ONTO.example: Scarcely had she stepped onto the stage when the crowd cheered.
HAD SHE STEPPED ONTO.exampleZh: Scarcely had + 主詞 + p.p. ... when ...：一…就…。

THE MORE FLUENT.example: The more you practice, the more fluent you become.
THE MORE FLUENT.exampleZh: The 比較級..., the 比較級...：越…就越…。

DID THEY REALIZE.example: Little did they realize that the decision would change everything.
DID THEY REALIZE.exampleZh: 否定意味的 Little 放句首要倒裝：Little did they realize...。

TO LEARN.example: Were he to learn the truth, he would be furious.
TO LEARN.exampleZh: Were + 主詞 + to V：與未來相反的假設（= If he were to learn）。

TO BE MAINTAINED.example: Were the distinction to be maintained, the apparent contradiction would disappear.
TO BE MAINTAINED.exampleZh: Were＋主詞＋to be＋過去分詞構成正式假設被動倒裝。

AS IT MAY.example: Be that as it may, the unresolved question of authority remains.
AS IT MAY.exampleZh: Be that as it may 是固定讓步語，意為即便如此。

DID SHE SUPPOSE.example: Not for a moment did she suppose that the invitation could be refused without consequence.
DID SHE SUPPOSE.exampleZh: 否定副詞語置首，倒裝為 did she suppose。

HAD THEY ENCOUNTERED.example: Seldom had they encountered a promise whose exceptions were so generously defined.
HAD THEY ENCOUNTERED.exampleZh: Seldom 置首引發過去完成式倒裝。

DOES NOT MATERIALLY.example: So narrow is the exception that invoking it does not materially alter the ordinary rule.

BE RIGOROUSLY.example: The statute requires that every algorithmic telemetry pipeline be rigorously audited for systemic algorithmic bias.
BE RIGOROUSLY.exampleZh: statute requires that 從句使用原形動詞虛擬式 be rigorously audited。

MUST NOT.example: The concept of must not is fundamental in this context.
MUST NOT.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「禁止、絕對不可」的核心意涵。

IS GOING TO.example: The concept of is going to is fundamental in this context.
IS GOING TO.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「is going to」的核心意涵。

AM GOING TO VISIT.example: The concept of am going to visit is fundamental in this context.
AM GOING TO VISIT.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「這個週末有什麼計畫？」的核心意涵。

ARE YOU GOING TO.example: 「Q: are you going to attend the company dinner tonight? A: No, I am not.」空格中應填入：
ARE YOU GOING TO.exampleZh: 根據回答「No, I'm not.」，問題應為 be 動詞開頭的未來式問句。

SHOULD NOT.example: The concept of should not is fundamental in this context.
SHOULD NOT.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「不應該」的核心意涵。

READ THE ATTACHMENT.example: The concept of read the attachment is fundamental in this context.
READ THE ATTACHMENT.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「選 D」的核心意涵。

BECAUSE OF GOOD SALES.example: The concept of because of good sales is fundamental in this context.
BECAUSE OF GOOD SALES.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「業績好」的核心意涵。

ON MONDAYS.example: The concept of on mondays is fundamental in this context.
ON MONDAYS.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「週一休館」的核心意涵。

EATING EGGS.example: The concept of eating eggs is fundamental in this context.
EATING EGGS.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「肉與蛋」的核心意涵。

COOKING AT HOME.example: The concept of cooking at home is fundamental in this context.
COOKING AT HOME.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「選 B」的核心意涵。

CREATE AN ACCOUNT.example: The concept of create an account is fundamental in this context.
CREATE AN ACCOUNT.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「首先建立帳號」的核心意涵。

IN THE PARK.example: The concept of in the park is fundamental in this context.
IN THE PARK.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「我們將在公園集合」的核心意涵。

ALWAYS ARRIVES.meaning: 本題測驗副詞與動詞變化
ALWAYS ARRIVES.example: The concept of always arrives is fundamental in this context.
ALWAYS ARRIVES.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「本題測驗副詞與動詞變化」的核心意涵。

ARE GOING TO.example: We are going to take the top deck to see the city landmarks clearly.
ARE GOING TO.exampleZh: 題目：We ___ take the top deck to see the city landmarks clearly. 主詞為 We，搭配的未來式結構為 are going to + 原形動詞。

IS GOING TO HAVE.example: Our store is going to have a huge sale next Friday.
IS GOING TO HAVE.exampleZh: 句子中有 next Friday，表示未來的事情，因此使用 be going to 的未來式。

HARDLY EVER.example: He hardly ever buys clothes online because he prefers to try them on.
HARDLY EVER.exampleZh: 後半句說「他偏好試穿」，代表他「幾乎不」在網路上買衣服。

IS GOING TO RAIN.example: Take an UMBRELLA with you. It is going to rain later this evening.
IS GOING TO RAIN.exampleZh: 提醒對方帶傘是因為預測「今晚稍晚會下雨」，表示未來的事情，用 is going to rain。

AM GOING TO.example: A: Are you ready for the trip? B: Almost! I am going to pack my bags tonight.
AM GOING TO.exampleZh: 表示已計畫好的未來行動用 am going to + 原形動詞。

IN THE MORNING.example: The concept of in the morning is fundamental in this context.
IN THE MORNING.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「早上去逛當地市場」的核心意涵。

RECYCLE PLASTIC BOTTLES.example: The concept of recycle plastic bottles is fundamental in this context.
RECYCLE PLASTIC BOTTLES.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「回收塑膠瓶」的核心意涵。

ARE NOT SUPPOSED TO.example:
A: Did you see the sign? 
B: Yes, it says 'Staff Only'. We are not supposed to enter this room.
ARE NOT SUPPOSED TO.exampleZh: 牌子寫「員工專區」，表示我們「不應該/不被允許」進入。

DO I HAVE TO.example: A: do i have to sign in to use this application? B: Yes, you need an account.
DO I HAVE TO.exampleZh: have to 的疑問句需藉助助動詞 do/does/did。

REALLY SHOULD.example: A: I typed the wrong number on the document. B: You really should tell the boss before he finds out himself.
REALLY SHOULD.exampleZh: really should 帶有強烈建議的意思：「你真的應該在老闆自己發現前告訴他」。

WAS DISCUSSING.example: The marketing team was discussing the new strategy when the CEO walked into the room.
WAS DISCUSSING.exampleZh: 由 when 帶出的過去簡單式（walked）可知，主要子句應使用過去進行式，表示當時正在進行的動作。

WAS WRITING.example: I was writing an email to my colleague when my computer suddenly shut down.
WAS WRITING.exampleZh: 描述過去某個時間點正在發生的事（寫信），被另一個突發動作（關機）打斷，使用過去進行式。

TO ANSWER.example: A: Did you manage to finish the report? B: No, I stopped to answer a phone call, and then it was time to leave.
TO ANSWER.exampleZh: stop to V 表示「停下原本的動作，轉而去做另一件事」。

WERE HIKING.example: While they were hiking through the dense forest, they discovered a rare species of bird.
WERE HIKING.exampleZh: While 引導的子句通常使用進行式，表示在過去一段持續的時間內（徒步旅行中）發生了另一件事（發現鳥類）。

TO WORK.example: Many employees plan to work from home at least twice a week.
TO WORK.exampleZh: plan（計畫）後面必須接不定詞（to V）當作受詞。

WERE TESTING.example: At 8 PM last night, the technicians were testing the new artificial intelligence system.
WERE TESTING.exampleZh: 句子明確點出過去的特定時間（At 8 PM last night），此時應使用過去進行式表示當時正在進行的動作。

TO LOCK.meaning: 忘記去做某事（事情還沒做）
TO LOCK.example: I completely forgot to lock the office door when I left yesterday evening.
TO LOCK.exampleZh: forget to V 表示「忘記去做某事（事情還沒做）」。

WERE YOU DOING.example: A: What were you doing when the earthquake hit? B: I was reading a book in the living room.
WERE YOU DOING.exampleZh: 根據回答「I was reading...」以及 when 帶出的過去時間，問句需用過去進行式。

WERE DISCUSSING.example: They were discussing the budget for next year when the power went out.
WERE DISCUSSING.exampleZh: 描述過去正在進行的動作（討論預算）被突發事件（停電 went out）打斷。

WAS PREPARING.example: While the chef was preparing the ingredients, the waiters were setting up the tables.
WAS PREPARING.exampleZh: While 引導的子句常用進行式，且後方子句為 were setting up，表示過去同時正在發生的兩個動作。

WAS LISTENING.example: I was listening to a podcast about remote work when I fell asleep.
WAS LISTENING.exampleZh: 表示在過去某時正在聽 podcast，接著發生了睡著（fell asleep）的動作。

TO PURSUE.example: She decided to pursue a new career path after working in finance for ten years.
TO PURSUE.exampleZh: decide 後面必須接不定詞（to V）作受詞。

WAS GIVING.example: The CEO was giving a speech about sustainable development when the microphone stopped working.
WAS GIVING.exampleZh: 過去某個持續進行的動作（正在演講）被另一個過去動作（麥克風壞掉）打斷，用過去進行式。

WERE UPGRADING.meaning: While 引導的過去時間子句
WERE UPGRADING.example: While the engineers were upgrading the software, they found a critical bug in the system.
WERE UPGRADING.exampleZh: While 引導的過去時間子句，表示當時正在進行升級（upgrading）的動作。

WERE WAITING.example: They were waiting for the bus when it started to rain heavily.
WERE WAITING.exampleZh: 描述在過去某個時間點正在進行的動作（等公車），被下雨這件事打斷。

WERE ANALYZING.example: The scientists were analyzing the effects of the new diet when the fire alarm rang.
WERE ANALYZING.exampleZh: 這是一個測試「過去進行式」的句子，表示在過去某個特定時間點（火災警報響起時）正在進行的動作，因此選擇 B. were analyzing。

WERE MEASURING.example: A: What were the researchers doing in the lab yesterday morning? B: They were measuring the participants' blood pressure and heart rates.
WERE MEASURING.exampleZh: 問句使用的是過去進行式 (were doing)，表示過去某段時間正在進行的事，故回答也應保持一致，使用 A. were measuring。

TO LAUNCH.example: The local clinic plans to launch a free wellness program for seniors next month.
TO LAUNCH.exampleZh: 動詞 plan 後面必須接不定詞 (to + V)，表示計畫要做的事，因此正確答案為 B. to launch。

WAS UPDATING.example: The nurse was updating the patient's medical records when the hospital's computer system crashed.
WAS UPDATING.exampleZh: 句意表示當電腦系統當機的那一刻，護士「正在」更新病歷。

TO CONSTRUCT.example: The mayor agreed to construct more bike lanes in the downtown area to reduce traffic jams.
TO CONSTRUCT.exampleZh: 動詞 agree 後面必須接不定詞 (to + V) 表示同意去做某事，因此選擇 D. to construct。

WAS WAITING.example: I was waiting for the express train when I heard the station announcement.
WAS WAITING.exampleZh: 表示在過去聽到廣播的瞬間，我「正在」等車，需使用過去進行式 B. was waiting。

WERE FIXING.example: A: Why was the road blocked yesterday? B: Because the workers were fixing the broken traffic lights.
WERE FIXING.exampleZh: 問句描述昨天的情況，回答說明當時正在進行的動作（修復紅綠燈），因此需要用過去進行式 C. were fixing。

TO TAKE.example: To save money and protect the environment, we decided to take public transport instead of driving.
TO TAKE.exampleZh: 動詞 decide 後面固定接不定詞 (to + V) 表示決定去做某事，因此選 D. to take。

WAS DRAFTING.meaning: 當電源突然中斷時，我『正在
WAS DRAFTING.example: I was drafting an important email to a client when the power suddenly went out.
WAS DRAFTING.exampleZh: 「當電源突然中斷時，我『正在』起草電子郵件」，一個過去動作打斷了另一個過去正在進行的動作，需用過去進行式，選 B。

TO RAISE.example: During the meeting, she hesitated to raise the controversial issue because the boss was in a bad mood.
TO RAISE.exampleZh: 動詞 hesitate（猶豫）後面接不定詞 (to + V)，表示對做某事感到遲疑，因此正確答案為 D. to raise。

WERE DEBATING.example: A: Did they agree on the new marketing strategy? B: I'm not sure. They were debating it while they were having lunch.
WERE DEBATING.exampleZh: while 引導的子句使用過去進行式 (were having)，主要子句描述當時也正在進行的另一個動作，時態需一致，因此選 C. were debating。

WERE PRACTICING.example: The traditional dancers were practicing their routine when it suddenly started to pour rain.
WERE PRACTICING.exampleZh: 句意表示突然下大雨時，舞者們「正在」練習舞步。

TO SEE.example: Tourists from all over the world travel to Taiwan to see the famous sky lanterns.
TO SEE.exampleZh: 不定詞 (to + V) 在句中用來表示目的，「為了看天燈」所以來台灣，因此選 D. to see。

WERE PERFORMING.example: A: How was the concert at the cultural center? B: Amazing! While the musicians were performing , the crowd cheered loudly.
WERE PERFORMING.exampleZh: while 連接過去某段時間內正在進行的動作，且對話談論的是過去的一場演唱會，故需使用過去進行式 A. were performing。

WAS READING.example: I was reading the instruction manual when the device suddenly shut off by itself.
WAS READING.exampleZh: 當設備突然自己關機時，我「正在」閱讀說明書。

TO ISSUE.example: The online store refused to issue a full refund for the laptop, stating that the warranty had expired.
TO ISSUE.exampleZh: 動詞 refuse（拒絕）後面必須接不定詞 (to + V)，表示拒絕做某事，因此正確答案為 C. to issue。

WAS HELPING.example: A: Did you resolve the billing issue? B: No, the customer service representative was helping me when the line suddenly disconnected.
WAS HELPING.exampleZh: 對話表示在電話突然斷線的那個時刻，客服人員「正在」協助我。

TO SIGN.example: The gym requires all members to sign a health form before using the swimming pool.
TO SIGN.exampleZh: require somebody to do something（要求某人做某事）是固定用法，需接不定詞，故選 D. to sign。

WAS STIRRING.example: The chef was stirring the soup when the power suddenly went out.
WAS STIRRING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：when 帶出的子句為過去簡單式（表示突發事件），主要子句應使用過去進行式，表示當時正在進行的動作。

TO DELAY.example: The CEO decided to delay the launch date of the new product to ensure quality.
TO DELAY.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：動詞 decide 後面固定接不定詞 (to V) 作為受詞，表示決定做某事。

WAS REVIEWING.example: While I was reviewing the contract, I noticed a minor spelling mistake.
WAS REVIEWING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：While 引導的子句通常使用進行式，且主要子句為過去式 (noticed)，故搭配過去進行式 was reviewing。

TO PAY.example: Management cannot afford to pay bonuses this year due to low profits.
TO PAY.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：afford 後方接動詞時，必須使用不定詞 (to V)，表示負擔得起去做某事。

WERE OPERATING.example: While the astronauts were operating the spacecraft, they lost connection with Earth.
WERE OPERATING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：背景事件發生在過去，While 引導的持續性動作需使用過去進行式。

TO COMPLETE.example: They aim to complete the construction of the new laboratory by next spring.
TO COMPLETE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：動詞 aim (目標在於) 後方需接不定詞 (to V)，表示未來的企圖或目標。

WERE CLEANING.example: While the volunteers were cleaning the beach, they collected fifty bags of trash.
WERE CLEANING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：過去進行的長動作 (cleaning) 配上過去發生的短動作或結論 (collected)，需用過去進行式。

WAS TAKING.example:
A: Why didn't you answer my call? 
B: I was taking a shower when the phone rang.
WAS TAKING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：回答過去某個特定時間點正在進行的動作，使用過去進行式 (was taking)。

WERE MIXING.meaning: 我們正在混合化學物質
WERE MIXING.example:
A: What happened at the lab? 
B: We were mixing the chemicals when the glass broke.
WERE MIXING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：玻璃破裂 (broke) 是過去發生的瞬間，當時「我們正在混合化學物質」，故用過去進行式 were mixing。

WAS INTERVIEWING.example: The journalist was interviewing the celebrity when the celebrity suddenly got angry.
WAS INTERVIEWING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：突然生氣 (got angry) 為過去式突發事件，前面正在進行的採訪動作需用過去進行式。

TO SECURE.example: Many startup founders struggle to secure funding during their first year of business.
TO SECURE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：struggle to V 表示「努力/掙扎著去做某事」，需接不定詞。

WERE PREPARING.example: While the locals were preparing the festival, a sudden thunderstorm ruined the decorations.
WERE PREPARING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：背景動作發生在過去 (ruined 為過去式)，表示當地人當時正在準備，因此用過去進行式 were preparing。

WAS WATCHING.example:
A: What was John doing at 8 PM? 
B: He was watching a movie with his family.
WAS WATCHING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：問句使用了過去進行式詢問過去特定時間正在做什麼，回答也應一致使用過去進行式。

TO PICK.example:
A: Why did she leave early? 
B: She intends to pick her daughter from school.
TO PICK.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：intend (打算) 後面要接不定詞 (to V)，表示計畫要去做的事。

WAS BROWSING.example: I was browsing the store's website when the payment page froze.
WAS BROWSING.exampleZh: 配合 when 引導的過去簡單式（froze），主要子句應使用過去進行式（was/were + V-ing）表示當時正在進行的動作。

TO BUY.example: Many consumers hesitate to buy expensive electronics online.
TO BUY.exampleZh: 動詞 hesitate（猶豫）後面必須接不定詞（to + V）當接受詞。

WAS ENTERING.example:
A: Why didn't you complete the order?
B: I was entering my credit card details when the screen went black.
WAS ENTERING.exampleZh: 從 when the screen went black（螢幕變黑時）可知，對話描述的是過去某個突發事件發生當下「正在進行」的動作，須用過去進行式。

WERE TRAINING.example: The athletes were training in the gym when the fire alarm sounded.
WERE TRAINING.exampleZh: when 子句為過去簡單式（sounded），表示過去發生的單一事件。

WAS RUNNING.example: He was running heavily on the treadmill when he unexpectedly felt a sharp pain.
WAS RUNNING.exampleZh: when 引導過去簡單式（felt）的瞬間動作，主要子句則需使用過去進行式（was running）來描述當時持續在進行的跑步狀態。

WAS EXPLAINING.example: The HR director was explaining the benefits package when the projector turned off.
WAS EXPLAINING.exampleZh: 配合 when 引導的過去突發事件（turned off），主要子句應使用過去進行式表示當時正在說明的動作。

TO WATCH.example: New staff members are instructed to watch this safety video by Friday.
TO WATCH.exampleZh: instruct sb. to do sth. 被動語態為 be instructed to do sth.（被指示去做某事）。

WAS SETTING.example:
A: Where was Mark during the orientation?
B: He was setting up his computer at his new desk.
WAS SETTING.exampleZh: 問句用 was 詢問過去特定時間（during the orientation）的狀態，回答時應使用過去進行式表達「他當時正在設定電腦」。

WERE WALKING.example: We were walking along the river when the fireworks show began.
WERE WALKING.exampleZh: when 子句為過去簡單式（began），主要子句描述當時正在持續的動作，應使用過去進行式。

TO RENT.example:
A: How can we get to the island?
B: We prepared to rent a boat early in the morning.
TO RENT.exampleZh: 動詞 prepare（準備）後方接另一個動詞時，需使用不定詞（to + V）表示目的或計畫的動作。

WAS DOING.example:
A: Did you see the parade?
B: No, I was doing souvenir shopping when it passed by.
WAS DOING.exampleZh: when it passed by 是過去發生的瞬間動作，回答者表示遊行經過時，他「正在」買紀念品，需使用過去進行式。

WAS FLASHING.example: The battery indicator was flashing red when the laptop completely shut down.
WAS FLASHING.exampleZh: when 引導過去簡單式（shut down），表示過去事件，主要子句應使用過去進行式，表示筆電關機當時指示燈「正在閃爍」。

WERE CLOSING.example:
A: Why didn't the file save?
B: You were closing the application while it was still loading data.
WERE CLOSING.exampleZh: 由 while it was still loading data（當它還在讀取資料時）可知背景時間在過去，且表示當時正在進行的動作，應配搭過去進行式。

TO NEED.example:
A: Is the installation finished?
B: Not yet. The system seems to need more time to download the necessary files.
TO NEED.exampleZh: 連綴動詞 seem 後方若接動詞，必須使用不定詞（to + V）。

TO BAN.example: Many cities plan to ban single-use plastic bags by next year.
TO BAN.exampleZh: 【文法】動詞 plan 後面必須接不定詞（to V）表示「計畫做某事」。

WERE PLANTING.example: The volunteers were planting trees in the park when it started raining heavily.
WERE PLANTING.exampleZh: 【時態】when 引導的子句表示過去某個發生的時間點，主要子句應使用過去進行式表示「當時正在進行的動作」。

TO RIDE.example: Instead of driving to work, she chose to ride a bicycle to reduce carbon emissions.
TO RIDE.exampleZh: 【文法】動詞 choose（過去式為 chose）後方需接不定詞（to V）表示「選擇去做某事」。

WAS ATTENDING.example: I was attending a virtual meeting when my internet connection unexpectedly dropped.
WAS ATTENDING.exampleZh: 【時態】when my internet connection dropped 是過去發生的單一事件，當時「我」正在進行某個動作，應使用過去進行式。

TO CHOOSE.example: The company allows employees to choose flexible hours as long as they complete their tasks.
TO CHOOSE.exampleZh: 【文法】allow 的用法是 allow someone to do something（允許某人做某事），後方必須接不定詞 (to V)。

TO WIN.example: The young gymnast hopes to win a gold medal at the upcoming international championship.
TO WIN.exampleZh: 【文法】hope（希望）後方應接不定詞 (to V)，表示對未來的期盼。

WAS SLEEPING.example:
A: Did you catch the baseball game last night?
B: No, I was sleeping when the final home run was hit.
WAS SLEEPING.exampleZh: 【時態】當全壘打被擊出時（過去的一瞬間），說話者「當時正在」睡覺。

WAS CHECKING.example:
A: How was your experience at the diner?
B: Terrible. The waiter was checking his phone while I was trying to order.
WAS CHECKING.exampleZh: 【時態】while I was trying to order (當我正試著點餐時) 使用了過去進行式，表示同一時段服務生也「正在」看手機，故前後應一致使用過去進行式。

TO SPEND.example: The professor urged his students to spend more time reading academic journals.
TO SPEND.exampleZh: 【文法】urge (敦促/呼籲) 的用法為 urge someone to do something，需搭配不定詞 (to V)。

WAS PATROLLING.example: The security guard was patrolling the exhibition when the lights went out.

WAS LISTENING TO.example: She was listening to a meditation podcast when she fell asleep.

TO STEAL.example: The hacker attempted to steal the company's financial data.

WERE DISTRIBUTING.example: We were distributing food at the shelter when the mayor arrived.

TO PRESERVE.example: They plan to preserve the historic monument to attract more tourists.

TO REDUCE.meaning: 本題測驗不定詞當虛主詞的真主詞
TO REDUCE.example: It is crucial to reduce your screen time before going to bed.
TO REDUCE.exampleZh: 本題測驗不定詞當虛主詞的真主詞。

WAS DOWNLOADING.example: The employee was downloading an attachment when the virus warning popped up.

TO FREEZE.example:
A: Did you freeze your credit card? 
B: Yes, the bank advised me to freeze the card after a fraud alert.

WAS TUTORING.example:
A: Did you join the fundraiser? 
B: No, I was tutoring the kids at the orphanage when it started.

TO PROTECT.example:
A: Why was the artifact removed? 
B: The curator wanted to protect it from the intense sunlight.

WAS TRYING.example:
A: Was the email a scam? 
B: Yes, the sender was trying to deceive me when I noticed the fake logo.

TO UPDATE.example:
A: How can we protect our accounts? 
B: The IT department requires everyone to update complex passwords regularly.

WALK THE DOGS.example: The concept of walk the dogs is fundamental in this context.
WALK THE DOGS.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「本題測驗閱讀理解」的核心意涵。

TO PROVIDE EMPLOYMENT.example: The concept of to provide employment is fundamental in this context.
TO PROVIDE EMPLOYMENT.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「本題測驗閱讀理解」的核心意涵。

DOING LIGHT EXERCISE.example: The concept of doing light exercise is fundamental in this context.
DOING LIGHT EXERCISE.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「本題測驗閱讀理解」的核心意涵。

AN ATTACK WAS STOPPED.meaning: 我們的系統擋下了攻擊
AN ATTACK WAS STOPPED.example: The concept of an attack was stopped is fundamental in this context.
AN ATTACK WAS STOPPED.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「我們的系統擋下了攻擊」的核心意涵。

PUTTING ITEMS INTO BOXES.meaning: 當消息宣布時作者正在做什麼？
PUTTING ITEMS INTO BOXES.example: The concept of putting items into boxes is fundamental in this context.
PUTTING ITEMS INTO BOXES.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「當消息宣布時作者正在做什麼？」的核心意涵。

TO FIX THE ELEVATOR.example: The concept of to fix the elevator is fundamental in this context.
TO FIX THE ELEVATOR.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「本題測驗閱讀理解」的核心意涵。

WERE OBSERVING.example: They were observing the chemical reaction when the glass tube broke.
WERE OBSERVING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：本題測試過去進行式。

WAS CHOPPING.example: The chef was chopping the vegetables when the pot boiled over.
WAS CHOPPING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：當鍋子沸騰溢出 (boiled over) 時，廚師「正在切」蔬菜，強調過去某時間點正在進行的動作，因此用過去進行式 was chopping，選 (D)。

TO ADD.example:
A: Do you like the curry?
B: Yes, but the chef warned me not to add too much chili sauce.
TO ADD.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：warn sb. (not) to V 表示「警告某人（不要）做某事」，必須使用不定詞。

TO WEAR.example: The new policy requires all staff to wear a security badge at all times.
TO WEAR.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：動詞 require（要求）的用法為 require sb. to V，表示「要求某人做某事」。

WAS DELIVERING.example: The director was delivering a speech when the microphone stopped working.
WAS DELIVERING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：麥克風故障是過去瞬間發生的事，當時主管「正在發表」演講，須用過去進行式，正確答案為 (A) was delivering。

TO PAUSE.example: She decided to pause her acting career to spend more time with her family.
TO PAUSE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：動詞 decide（決定）後面必須接不定詞 (to V)，表示決定去做某事，因此答案為 (C)。

TO WASH.example: It is essential to wash your hands frequently while traveling abroad.
TO WASH.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：句型 It is + 形容詞 + to V 中，It 為虛主詞，真正的主詞是後面的不定詞片語 (to wash...)，因此選 (B)。

WAS ANALYZING.example: I was analyzing the data when the computer system crashed.
WAS ANALYZING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：電腦當機是過去瞬間動作，當時我「正在分析」數據，須使用過去進行式，選 (D)。

TO THINK.example: The professor encouraged the students to think outside the box.
TO THINK.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：動詞 encourage 的用法為 encourage sb. to V（鼓勵某人做某事），故選 (A) to think。

TO ALLOW.example:
A: Did you read the company memo?
B: Yes, they plan to allow remote work permanently.
TO ALLOW.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：動詞 plan（計畫）後面必須接不定詞 (to V)，表示計畫去做某事，因此正確答案為 (D) to allow。

TO REBUILD.example: The city council intends to rebuild the old bridge before the rainy season begins.

TO RESOLVE.example: My SUPERIOR urged me to resolve the conflict with my team member as soon as possible.

WAS DEALING.example:
A: Why didn't you answer my call?
B: I was dealing with a difficult client when you called.

TO HAVE.example: The new employee seems to have a lot of experience in resolving customer complaints.

WAS EVALUATING.example: The doctor was evaluating my SYMPTOM when the clinic lost power.

WAS TRAINING.example:
A: How did you injure your knee?
B: I was training for the TOURNAMENT when I tripped on the track.

TO DISPLAY.example: The director arranged to display the rare SCULPTURE in the main hall of the museum.

WAS PERFORMING.example: The ORCHESTRA was performing a famous symphony when the lights suddenly went out.

WAS PAINTING.example:
A: Why didn't you talk to the painter?
B: He was painting a portrait of a guest when I walked by, so I didn't want to disturb him.

WAS CALCULATING.example: I was calculating my monthly BUDGET when I realized my expenses had doubled.

TO PROVIDE.example: The government promised to provide financial aid to businesses affected by the INFLATION.

WAS MAKING.example:
A: Why was your credit card declined?
B: I was making an online TRANSACTION overseas, and the bank flagged it as suspicious.

WERE TALKING.example: I couldn't hear what the speaker was saying because the people behind me were talking loudly.
WERE TALKING.exampleZh: 主要子句（couldn't hear）是過去式，表示當時聽不到是因為後面的人「當時正在」大聲說話，需用過去進行式。

WAS STRUGGLING.example: While the government was struggling to find a solution to the pollution problem, local activists organized a massive cleanup event on the beach.
WAS STRUGGLING.exampleZh: 後半句為過去簡單式（organized），While 帶出的背景動作通常為過去進行式，表示當時政府正為了找尋解方而努力。

TO FIRE.example: The manager threatened to fire the employee if he continued to be late for work.
TO FIRE.exampleZh: threaten（威脅）後面須接不定詞（to V），表示威脅要去做某事。

TO CREATE.example:
A: Why did you hire a health coach?
B: I failed to create a balanced meal plan on my own.
TO CREATE.exampleZh: 動詞 fail 後面必須接不定詞（to + V）表示「未能做到某事」。

TO LEAVE.example:
A: Should I leave it plugged in overnight?
B: No, the manufacturer warns users not to leave the charger plugged in overnight.
TO LEAVE.exampleZh: warn sb. not to do sth. 是固定用法，表示「警告某人不要做某事」，因此必須接不定詞（to leave）。

TO ESTABLISH.example: The government aims to establish a nationwide network of electric vehicle charging stations within five years.
TO ESTABLISH.exampleZh: 【文法】動詞 aim 表示「目標在於、打算」時，後方接不定詞 (to V) 以構成 aim to do something。

TO BOOK.example: If you want a table by the window, you had better attempt to book it in advance.
TO BOOK.exampleZh: 【文法】attempt (嘗試/試圖) 後方應接不定詞 (to V)。

TO ACQUIRE.meaning: 對某人來說做某事是...的
TO ACQUIRE.example: It is almost impossible for an average earner to acquire a property in this expensive district.
TO ACQUIRE.exampleZh: 本題測驗不定詞的特殊句型。

WERE DECORATING.example:
A: Is the charity gala still happening tonight? 
B: Yes, they were decorating the venue when the storm suddenly hit, but everything is fine now.

TO RECEIVE.example:
A: Why are they arguing? 
B: The residents demand to receive compensation from the construction company for the noise pollution.

SUPPLYING CLEAN WATER.example: The concept of supplying clean water is fundamental in this context.
SUPPLYING CLEAN WATER.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「專注於提供乾淨水源」的核心意涵。

TO KNOW.meaning: 本題在短文中考不定詞用法
TO KNOW.example:
Management Advice: When dealing with a DISPUTE, a good leader shouldn't pretend to know everything. Listening to both sides is always the best approach.
Q: Fill in the blank with the correct grammar form.
TO KNOW.exampleZh: 本題在短文中考不定詞用法。

TO LOSE.example:
A: Why did you hire a personal trainer?
B: I was struggling to lose weight on my own.

TO INVESTIGATE.meaning: 本題在短文中考不定詞用法
TO INVESTIGATE.example:
Banking Alert: Customers who notice any unusual charges on their statement should report them immediately. The bank claims to investigate all fraudulent activities within a week.
Q: Choose the correct grammar form.
TO INVESTIGATE.exampleZh: 本題在短文中考不定詞用法。

MUST HAVE.example: The laboratory was locked all night, but the window was open this morning. Someone must have left it open before locking up.
MUST HAVE.exampleZh: must have＋過去分詞表示根據線索推測過去。

TO HAVE BEEN DAMAGED.example: The bridge is thought to have been damaged during the storm last week.
TO HAVE BEEN DAMAGED.exampleZh: is thought to have been damaged 表示「被認為先前已受損」。

HAVE BEEN TESTING.example: The trial is still under way. Researchers have been testing the new coating for six months now.
HAVE BEEN TESTING.exampleZh: still under way 與 for six months now 表示從過去持續至今的測試，用現在完成進行式。

HAD NOT LENT.meaning: 過去事件造成現在結果
HAD NOT LENT.example: The report refers to a single incident: you lent me your access card yesterday. I cannot find my own now. If you had not lent me your card yesterday, I would be unable to enter today.
HAD NOT LENT.exampleZh: 過去事件造成現在結果，混合條件句用 If＋過去完成式、would＋原形。

ARE BEING RENOVATED.example: Which form presents the renovation as ongoing now? The rooms are being renovated, so guests must use the west entrance.
ARE BEING RENOVATED.exampleZh: 題目指定描述現在正在施工。

BE CHANGED.example: The password should be changed by the administrator before anyone outside the team is given access.
BE CHANGED.exampleZh: by the administrator 指明執行更換者，password 是受動對象。

WAS BEING CONVERTED.example: The conversion was only half finished when funding was withdrawn. Which form describes work in progress at that past moment? The warehouse was being converted into a community centre.
WAS BEING CONVERTED.exampleZh: 題目要呈現過去那一刻仍在進行的改建，用 was being converted。

HAS BEEN STUDYING.example: She began lessons last spring and still attends them. Which form links that start to an activity continuing now? She has been studying the language for almost a year.
HAS BEEN STUDYING.exampleZh: 指定從去年春天延續到現在仍進行中的學習，用現在完成進行式 has been studying。

HAD BEEN WAITING.example: We had been waiting at the station for an hour when the cancellation was finally announced.
HAD BEEN WAITING.exampleZh: for an hour 表等待持續時間，when 引出已發生的過去宣布時點，需以過去完成進行式連接更早開始的等待。

MUST HAVE BEEN RAINING.example: The cars emerging from the tunnel were covered in rain. Which form expresses a strong deduction about recent rain beyond the hill? It must have been raining there.
MUST HAVE BEEN RAINING.exampleZh: must have been raining 表對先前降雨作強烈肯定推測。

HAS BEEN RESTORED.example: The gate will remain closed until the damaged seal has been restored by the maintenance team.
HAS BEEN RESTORED.exampleZh: seal 是維修團隊修復的對象，by 指明施事者。

CATER FOR.meaning: 滿足某群人的飲食或其他需求
CATER FOR.example: The café can cater for guests who do not eat dairy products. Which expression means to provide suitable food for them?
CATER FOR.exampleZh: cater for 表示滿足某群人的飲食或其他需求。

HAD LIFTED.example: By the time we reached the clearing, the mist had lifted.
HAD LIFTED.exampleZh: reached 設定過去觀察時點，霧在抵達前已散去。

HAD CHARGED.meaning: 對已發生的過去表遺憾
HAD CHARGED.example: I wish I had charged the camera before leaving home; the battery is flat.
HAD CHARGED.exampleZh: 對已發生的過去表遺憾，用 wish + 過去完成式。

GIVE UP.example: Which expression means to stop playing fairly because the result seems impossible to change? The team must not give up before the final whistle.

WOULD HAVE BROUGHT.meaning: 活動與帶外套的時機均已過去
WOULD HAVE BROUGHT.example: The session ended an hour ago. If I had known it was outdoors, I would have brought a warmer jacket with me yesterday.
WOULD HAVE BROUGHT.exampleZh: 活動與帶外套的時機均已過去，if had known 對應未實現的過去結果 would have brought。

HAD BEEN RECORDED.example: The presenter said that the interview had been recorded the previous evening.
HAD BEEN RECORDED.exampleZh: said 與 the previous evening 建立過去轉述及更早完成的錄製。

PUT OFF.example: Which expression means to delay starting a task? We cannot put off cleaning the storeroom any longer.

TAKE CHARGE OF.example: Which expression means to take responsibility for a task? Could you take charge of checking the guest list?

WILL BE ABLE.example: Today is Monday. Please let us know by this Thursday whether you will be able to attend this coming Saturday. We need your actual availability, not a hypothetical past situation.
WILL BE ABLE.exampleZh: 詢問即將到來的星期六實際能否出席，will be able to 表未來能力或可行性。

HAD VISITED.example: She spoke as though she had visited the place before, although she later admitted it was her first visit.
HAD VISITED.exampleZh: 她假裝先前曾來訪，實際卻是第一次。

IS TO BE.example: The label is to face outwards. Which form keeps this as an instruction, rather than speculation about an earlier event? The label is to be positioned with its printed side facing outwards.
IS TO BE.exampleZh: is to be positioned 是對擺放方式的要求，保留原指示。

TO BE CHANGED.example: The design allows the cover to be changed without removing the pages.
TO BE CHANGED.exampleZh: allow + 受詞 + to be changed，封面被換。

HAD PUT.example: I wish the audience had put their phones on silent before the show began.
HAD PUT.exampleZh: 對過去未做的事遺憾，用 wish + 過去完成式。

HAD NOT ENDED UP.meaning: 過去未回覆的反事實條件
HAD NOT ENDED UP.example: I would have replied sooner if your message had not ended up in the wrong folder.
HAD NOT ENDED UP.exampleZh: 過去未回覆的反事實條件，用 had not ended up。

HAD DISAPPEARED.example: By the time we reached the ridge, the sun had disappeared behind the clouds.
HAD DISAPPEARED.exampleZh: 過去抵達前已不見，用過去完成式。

THE LESS TRAFFIC.example: The further we walked from the road, the less traffic we heard.

WAS LIVING.example: The interviewer asked me where I was living when the old theatre closed.
WAS LIVING.exampleZh: 間接問句用陳述語序，過去時背景為was living。

KNOCKING ON.example: I remember knocking on the door, but I cannot remember who opened it.
KNOCKING ON.exampleZh: remember doing回想已做事件，不是記得要做。

WOULD NOT.example: We closed the window so that the music would not disturb the neighbours.
WOULD NOT.exampleZh: 過去情境的目的子句用so that…would not，表示避免打擾。

GRADUALLY BECOMES QUIETER.example: If a sound fades away, it gradually becomes quieter.
GRADUALLY BECOMES QUIETER.exampleZh: fade away指逐漸消弱，不必涉及聲源移動。

HAD WE OPENED.example: Hardly had we opened the door when the alarm began to ring.

WOULD NOT BE STANDING.meaning: 過去未查時間造成現在困境
WOULD NOT BE STANDING.example: If we had checked the opening hours, we would not be standing outside a locked door now.
WOULD NOT BE STANDING.exampleZh: 過去未查時間造成現在困境，混合條件句用would not be standing。

HAD TRIED.meaning: 對已完成購買的過去遺憾
HAD TRIED.example: I wish I had tried the coat on before buying it; it is much heavier than I expected.
HAD TRIED.exampleZh: 對已完成購買的過去遺憾，用wish加過去完成式had tried。

BREAKING IN.example: The boots need breaking in before they are comfortable enough for a long walk.

HAD CHECKED.example: By the time we reached the junction, the guide had checked the route twice already.
HAD CHECKED.exampleZh: reached為過去參照點，already與twice表示此前已完成兩次，用過去完成式。

HAS BEEN DISCUSSING.example: The committee has been discussing the proposed tax reforms for three hours without reaching a consensus.
HAS BEEN DISCUSSING.exampleZh: 句中有「for three hours」強調動作持續進行且尚未結束，符合現在完成進行式的使用時機。

MUST HAVE MISSED.example: The CEO's flight was delayed by a severe storm, so she must have missed the opening speech.
MUST HAVE MISSED.exampleZh: 基於班機延誤的事實，對過去發生的事情作肯定推測，應使用「must have + V-p.p.」，表示「一定已經錯過了」。

HAVE BEEN INVESTIGATING.example: Scientists have been investigating this rare phenomenon since 2015, yet its true origin remains a mystery.
HAVE BEEN INVESTIGATING.exampleZh: 「since 2015」加上現在式「remains」，表示動作從過去持續到現在，應選現在完成進行式。

IS BELIEVED.example: The latest software update is believed to have caused several system crashes across the network.
IS BELIEVED.exampleZh: 「被認為」造成了當機，主詞是軟體更新，應使用被動語態 is believed (to have + V-p.p.)。

MUST HAVE USED.example: There was no forced entry, meaning the thief must have used a key to open the safe.
MUST HAVE USED.exampleZh: 沒有強行破壞的痕跡，代表小偷過去「一定使用了」鑰匙，這是有強烈依據的過去推測。

HAVE BEEN INVESTING.example: Our competitors have been investing aggressively in artificial intelligence for the past few years to gain market share.
HAVE BEEN INVESTING.exampleZh: for the past few years 表示動作的持續性，需使用現在完成進行式。

TO BE ANNOUNCED.example: The new regulations are rumored to be announced next week, although official confirmation is still pending.
TO BE ANNOUNCED.exampleZh: be rumored to be + V-p.p. 表示「據傳將被...」，法規是被公布的對象。

HAD BEEN ADVOCATING.example: The environmental group had been advocating for stricter carbon emission laws long before the recent climate summit.
HAD BEEN ADVOCATING.exampleZh: 在「過去的」氣候高峰會之前，就一直持續在倡議，屬於過去完成進行式的使用情境（比過去更早並持續）。

IS THOUGHT.example: The ancient manuscript is thought to have been written by a renowned scholar in the 12th century.
IS THOUGHT.exampleZh: 手稿「被認為」寫於12世紀，需用被動語態 is thought (to have been written)。

MUST HAVE BEEN.example: The sales figures are incredibly low this quarter. The marketing campaign must have been a total failure.
MUST HAVE BEEN.exampleZh: 基於銷售額極低的強烈證據，推測過去的行銷活動「一定是」徹底失敗了。

TO HAVE BEEN STOLEN.example: The confidential documents are reported to have been stolen from the executive's office last night.
TO HAVE BEEN STOLEN.exampleZh: 報導現在發生（are reported），但失竊發生在昨晚，需用 to have been stolen 表達過去完成的被動概念。

HAS BEEN RISING.example: Inflation has been rising steadily over the past six months, causing widespread concern among consumers.
HAS BEEN RISING.exampleZh: over the past six months 表達這半年來不斷進行的趨勢，選現在完成進行式。

ARE PRESUMED.example: The rare artifacts are presumed to have been buried during a massive volcanic eruption.
ARE PRESUMED.exampleZh: 文物「被推定」掩埋於火山爆發，文物是受詞，需用被動語態 are presumed。

MUST HAVE RAINED.example: The streets are completely flooded this morning. It must have rained heavily last night.
MUST HAVE RAINED.exampleZh: 看到早上淹水的結果，推測昨晚「一定」下了大雨，用 must have + V-p.p.。

HAS BEEN EXAMINING.example: The legal team has been examining the contract details meticulously since the dispute arose.
HAS BEEN EXAMINING.exampleZh: 「since」引導的時間起點搭配「has been examining」，強調動作一直持續。

TO HAVE BEEN.example: The new marketing strategy is considered to have been extremely successful in boosting sales.
TO HAVE BEEN.exampleZh: 被認為（現在）在提升銷量上非常成功（過去的成果），用 to have been。

MUST HAVE GOTTEN.example: You left your umbrella at the office; you must have gotten drenched in that sudden downpour.
MUST HAVE GOTTEN.exampleZh: 對過去已經發生的事情作推測，「你當時一定淋濕了」，用 must have gotten。

HAVE BEEN FLUCTUATING.example: Global temperatures have been fluctuating at an alarming rate, prompting immediate calls for climate action.
HAVE BEEN FLUCTUATING.exampleZh: 描述近期不斷進行並持續中的變化趨勢，使用現在完成進行式最恰當。

TO BE HELD.example: The summit is scheduled to be held in Geneva, though the exact venue is yet to be confirmed.
TO BE HELD.exampleZh: 高峰會是「被舉辦」，因此在 scheduled 後方接不定詞的被動形式 to be held。

MUST HAVE PREPARED.meaning: 一定是在最後一刻才準備的
MUST HAVE PREPARED.example: The presentation slides are full of errors. He must have prepared them at the very last minute.
MUST HAVE PREPARED.exampleZh: 簡報充滿錯誤，強烈推測他過去「一定是在最後一刻才準備的」，用 must have + V-p.p.。

HAS BEEN REVIEWING.example: The legal counsel has been reviewing the proposed non-disclosure agreement for the past three weeks.
HAS BEEN REVIEWING.exampleZh: 句尾有 for the past three weeks（過去三週以來），表示動作從過去持續到現在且可能還在進行，應使用現在完成進行式 (has been reviewing)。

TO BE APPROVED.example: The amended privacy clause is expected to be approved by the regulatory committee next Monday.
TO BE APPROVED.exampleZh: be expected to 後面接原形動詞。

MUST NOT HAVE READ.example: The tenant breached the contract so easily; he must not have read the penalty terms carefully.
MUST NOT HAVE READ.exampleZh: 前半句指出租客輕易違約（發生在過去），推測他當時「一定沒有」仔細閱讀罰則，表對過去否定的強烈推測用 must not have V-en。

TO HAVE BEEN RETURNED.example: The intellectual property rights are widely assumed to have been returned to the original creator, despite the recent lawsuit.
TO HAVE BEEN RETURNED.exampleZh: 被廣泛認為 (are widely assumed) 的事情發生在過去，且權利是被歸還的，故使用 to have been + V-en 表達發生在過去的被動語態。

HAS BEEN GATHERING.example: The HR department has been gathering employee feedback regarding the new remote work policy since its implementation.
HAS BEEN GATHERING.exampleZh: 有 since 加上過去的時間點 (its implementation)，表示從過去持續到現在的動作，選現在完成進行式。

TO BE CLAIMED.example: All unused vacation days are required to be claimed before the end of the fiscal year.
TO BE CLAIMED.exampleZh: require sth to be V-en，特休假 (vacation days) 是「被申請、被使用」的，所以必須用被動不定詞 to be claimed。

TO BE TRANSITIONED.example: The annual performance review process is scheduled to be transitioned entirely to a digital platform by next quarter.
TO BE TRANSITIONED.exampleZh: is scheduled 後接 to V，而審查流程是被轉移到數位平台，故選被動不定詞 to be transitioned。

TO HAVE BEEN CORRUPTED.example: The experimental data is believed to have been corrupted by a sudden fluctuation in the laboratory's temperature yesterday.
TO HAVE BEEN CORRUPTED.exampleZh: is believed (現在被認為)，但破壞數據發生在昨天(yesterday)，須用 to have V-en 表過去，且數據是被破壞，故選 to have been corrupted。

HAVE BEEN WITNESSING.example: Travel agencies have been witnessing a sharp increase in bookings to eco-friendly destinations since the border restrictions were lifted.
HAVE BEEN WITNESSING.exampleZh: 自從邊境管制解除(since...)以來一直持續的現象，使用現在完成進行式 has/have been V-ing。

TO BE RESTORED.example: The historic castle, which was heavily damaged by fire, is expected to be restored to its former glory by 2028.
TO BE RESTORED.exampleZh: is expected 後接 to V，城堡是「被修復」，故使用被動不定詞 to be restored。

MUST HAVE SOLD.example: The flight was completely overbooked by noon. The airline must have sold more tickets than there were available seats.
MUST HAVE SOLD.exampleZh: 班機超賣是過去發生的事實，推論航空公司當時「一定賣了」超過座位的票，用 must have V-en。

HAVE BEEN PRAISING.example: Literary critics have been praising the author's unconventional narrative style since her debut novel was published.
HAVE BEEN PRAISING.exampleZh: since her debut novel was published 標示了過去的起點，延續至今的動作應選現在完成進行式。

TO BE WRITTEN.example: The highly anticipated sequel is rumored to be written from the perspective of the original villain.
TO BE WRITTEN.exampleZh: is rumored (被謠傳) 後接 to V，續集是「被寫成」，所以用 to be written。

MUST HAVE DELETED.example: The protagonist's sudden change of heart felt completely unearned. The editor must have deleted a crucial transitional chapter before publication.
MUST HAVE DELETED.exampleZh: 讀者感覺主角心境轉變太突兀，推測編輯在出版前「一定刪掉了」過渡章節。

TO HAVE ALTERED.example:
A: Have you reviewed the drafted policy?
B: Yes, but the new wording is confusing. The HR manager is believed to have altered it without consulting the legal team.
Q: What belongs in the blank?
TO HAVE ALTERED.exampleZh: is believed (現在被認為)，而更改措辭是過去發生的事，且為人資經理主動更改，故用 to have altered。

HAS BEEN OVERHAULING.example:
A: Why is the server down again?
B: The IT department has been overhauling the system infrastructure all morning. It should be back online soon.
Q: What belongs in the blank?
HAS BEEN OVERHAULING.exampleZh: all morning 強調從早上一直持續到現在的動作，使用現在完成進行式 has been overhauling (全面檢修)。

HAVE BEEN EVALUATING.meaning: 分析師們持續進行評估的動作
HAVE BEEN EVALUATING.example: The financial analysts have been evaluating the market trends rigorously to predict the next economic shift.
HAVE BEEN EVALUATING.exampleZh: 分析師們持續進行評估的動作，以預測未來的變動，用現在完成進行式最符合語境與文法。

TO HAVE BEEN REPEALED.example: The controversial employment regulations are confirmed to have been repealed by the parliament during yesterday's session.
TO HAVE BEEN REPEALED.exampleZh: are confirmed 是現在式，但廢除 (repeal) 發生在 yesterday，且法規是被廢除的，需用完成式被動不定詞 to have been repealed。

TO HAVE SHED.example: The documentary is widely considered to have shed light on the overlooked contributions of female scientists. The director must have done extensive archival research.
TO HAVE SHED.exampleZh: is widely considered (被廣泛認為)，而紀錄片揭露真相 (shed light on) 是過去已發生的成就，故用 to have shed。

HAVE BEEN ANALYZING.example: The financial advisors have been analyzing the recent market trends to identify new investment opportunities for their clients.
HAVE BEEN ANALYZING.exampleZh: 題目強調一段時間內持續進行的動作，且與現在有關。

TO HAVE BEEN TRIGGERED.meaning: 被廣泛認為已經由...引發
TO HAVE BEEN TRIGGERED.example: The sudden drop in cryptocurrency values is widely believed to have been triggered by the new regulatory policies announced yesterday.
TO HAVE BEEN TRIGGERED.exampleZh: 「被廣泛認為已經由...引發」，is believed 後接不定詞，因為動作發生在過去，用完成式被動不定詞 (to have been triggered)。

HAVE BEEN MONITORING.example: Environmental inspectors have been monitoring the water quality of the river since the chemical spill occurred.
HAVE BEEN MONITORING.exampleZh: 自化學外洩發生以來，調查員「一直在監測」水質，故用現在完成進行式。

TO HAVE MADE.example: The endangered species is reported to have made a remarkable recovery due to the new conservation laws.
TO HAVE MADE.exampleZh: 據報導，該物種已經復育成功。

MUST HAVE HALTED.meaning: 工廠一定是在檢查期間暫停了運作
MUST HAVE HALTED.example: The air pollution levels dropped significantly overnight. The factories must have halted their operations during the inspection.
MUST HAVE HALTED.exampleZh: 針對過去狀況的肯定推測：「工廠一定是在檢查期間暫停了運作」，用 must have + V-en。

HAS BEEN INVESTIGATING.example: The engineering team has been investigating the faulty braking mechanism since the first customer reported the issue.
HAS BEEN INVESTIGATING.exampleZh: 自第一位顧客回報問題以來，團隊「一直在調查」，使用現在完成進行式。

TO BE REMOVED.example: The contaminated food products are required to be removed from all supermarket shelves immediately to prevent further illness.
TO BE REMOVED.exampleZh: 產品「被要求從架上移除」，因此 require 後方接被動的不定詞 to be removed。

TO HAVE BEEN SUSCEPTIBLE.meaning: 過去一直易受過熱影響
TO HAVE BEEN SUSCEPTIBLE.example:
A: Is it true that the new smartphones are catching fire?
B: Yes, the battery units are known to have been susceptible to overheating under extreme pressure.
TO HAVE BEEN SUSCEPTIBLE.exampleZh: 電池被認為「過去一直易受過熱影響」，用完成式被動不定詞 (to have been susceptible)。

SUDDEN DIZZINESS.example: The concept of sudden dizziness is fundamental in this context.
SUDDEN DIZZINESS.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「sudden dizziness」的核心意涵。

HAVE BEEN EXAMINING.example: Psychologists have been examining the impact of social media on adolescent self-esteem for several years now.
HAVE BEEN EXAMINING.exampleZh: 「這幾年來一直在研究」，持續到現在的動作，用現在完成進行式。

TO HAVE BEEN CAUSED.meaning: 是過去由童年創傷所引起的
TO HAVE BEEN CAUSED.example: The unusual behavioral pattern is hypothesized to have been caused by severe childhood trauma.
TO HAVE BEEN CAUSED.exampleZh: 這種行為模式被假設「是過去由童年創傷所引起的」，使用完成式被動不定詞 (to have been caused)。

MUST NOT HAVE EXPLAINED.meaning: 研究人員一定沒有把指示解釋清楚
MUST NOT HAVE EXPLAINED.example: The participants reacted identically to the placebo. The researchers must not have explained the instructions clearly enough.
MUST NOT HAVE EXPLAINED.exampleZh: 對過去事實的否定推測：「研究人員一定沒有把指示解釋清楚」，用 must not have + V-en。

A FEELING OF CONFUSION.example: The concept of a feeling of confusion is fundamental in this context.
A FEELING OF CONFUSION.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「a feeling of confusion」的核心意涵。

HAS BEEN WORKING.example: The public relations team has been working tirelessly to salvage the brand's reputation since the scandal broke out.
HAS BEEN WORKING.exampleZh: 自醜聞爆發以來，公關團隊「一直持續在努力」挽救聲譽，用現在完成進行式。

MUST HAVE SABOTAGED.meaning: 對過去事件的肯定推測
MUST HAVE SABOTAGED.example: The confidential emails were leaked to the press. A high-ranking executive must have sabotaged the company's internal server.
MUST HAVE SABOTAGED.exampleZh: 對過去事件的肯定推測：「某個高層主管一定暗中破壞/駭入了內部伺服器」，用 must have V-en。

TO HAVE EMBEZZLED.example: The former CEO is widely known to have embezzled company funds for personal luxury expenses over the last five years.
TO HAVE EMBEZZLED.exampleZh: 前執行長被廣泛認為「過去曾經盜用公款」。

HAS BEEN ASSESSING.meaning: 本題測驗現在完成進行式
HAS BEEN ASSESSING.example: The human resources team has been assessing the staff's morale since the latest restructuring was announced.
HAS BEEN ASSESSING.exampleZh: 本題測驗現在完成進行式。

TO HAVE BEEN REVIEWED.example: The anonymous survey results are reported to have been reviewed by the executive board behind closed doors yesterday.
TO HAVE BEEN REVIEWED.exampleZh: 本題測驗複雜被動語態。

MUST HAVE IGNORED.example: Only half of the staff completed the questionnaire; the others must have ignored the due date notification.
MUST HAVE IGNORED.exampleZh: 本題測驗對過去事實的肯定推測。

HAS BEEN RENOVATING.example:
A: Why is the staff lounge closed?
B: The management has been renovating it for the past two weeks to create a better rest area.
HAS BEEN RENOVATING.exampleZh: 對話中提到 for the past two weeks，表示動作從過去兩週一直持續到現在還在進行中，需使用現在完成進行式。

TO HAVE PROVIDED.example: The new remote work arrangement is widely considered to have provided a major boost to overall staff well-being last year.
TO HAVE PROVIDED.exampleZh: 句中的 last year 點出提供幫助的時間點在過去，因此 consider 之後要接完成式不定詞 to have + V-p.p. 表達較早發生的動作。

MUST HAVE ROUTED.meaning: 一定是分類到垃圾信件匣了
MUST HAVE ROUTED.example: You didn't receive the wellness questionnaire? The automated mail server must have routed it to your spam folder by mistake.
MUST HAVE ROUTED.exampleZh: 針對過去發生的情況（沒收到信）做出強烈推斷，「一定是分類到垃圾信件匣了」，須用 must have + V-p.p.。

EXCESSIVE WORKING HOURS.example: The concept of excessive working hours is fundamental in this context.
EXCESSIVE WORKING HOURS.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「excessive working hours」的核心意涵。

HAVE BEEN OBSERVING.example: City planners have been observing the traffic congestion at the main intersection for several months to find a solution.
HAVE BEEN OBSERVING.exampleZh: for several months 表示動作持續了一段時間並延續至今，故選擇現在完成進行式。

TO BE ENFORCED.example: The controversial toll tax is scheduled to be enforced by the municipal council next spring.
TO BE ENFORCED.exampleZh: 稅收 (toll tax) 是被執行的，因此在 is scheduled 之後要接被動不定詞 to be + V-p.p.。

HAS BEEN FOCUSING.example:
A: Have they fixed the pothole on 5th Avenue?
B: No, the road crew has been focusing on the highway expansion instead.
HAS BEEN FOCUSING.exampleZh: 雖然沒有時間副詞，但語意上強調工程人員「這陣子一直專注於」高速公路擴建，用現在完成進行式最符合情境。

TO HAVE SHORTENED.example: The expanded bicycle lanes are proven to have shortened commuting times for residents in the suburbs over the last year.
TO HAVE SHORTENED.exampleZh: over the last year 指向過去的成果，are proven 後方需搭配完成式不定詞 to have shortened 來表示已經發生的縮短效果。

HAVE BEEN PATROLLING.example: Health inspectors have been patrolling local restaurants continuously to ensure proper sanitation standards are met.
HAVE BEEN PATROLLING.exampleZh: continuously 暗示動作從過去一直持續到現在，因此選現在完成進行式最能表達「持續不斷巡查」的語意。

TO BE WITHDRAWN.example: The contaminated batch of frozen vegetables is ordered to be withdrawn from all retail stores nationwide immediately.
TO BE WITHDRAWN.exampleZh: 蔬菜是「被撤下」，在 is ordered 之後應接被動的不定詞 to be withdrawn。

MUST HAVE ALLOWED.example: Several consumers reported food poisoning; the restaurant must have allowed cross-contamination in the kitchen yesterday.
MUST HAVE ALLOWED.exampleZh: 句末有 yesterday，推論昨天廚房裡「一定允許/發生了」交叉污染，用 must have + V-p.p.。

HAS BEEN EXECUTING.example:
A: Why is the dairy aisle empty?
B: The supermarket chain has been executing a massive recall on all milk products since this morning.
HAS BEEN EXECUTING.exampleZh: since this morning 表示動作從早上持續到說話的當下，需用現在完成進行式。

THROUGH POLLUTED FOOD SOURCES.example: The concept of through polluted food sources is fundamental in this context.
THROUGH POLLUTED FOOD SOURCES.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「受到污染的飼料」的核心意涵。

BREAKABLE PACKAGING.example: The concept of breakable packaging is fundamental in this context.
BREAKABLE PACKAGING.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「導致玻璃容易碎裂」的核心意涵。

HAVE BEEN SCRUTINIZING.example: Ethicists have been scrutinizing the potential biases in machine learning algorithms for years without finding a perfect solution.
HAVE BEEN SCRUTINIZING.exampleZh: for years 點出持續多年的動作，並強調一直進行到現在的狀態，因此使用現在完成進行式。

TO HAVE TRIGGERED.example: The autonomous driving software is alleged to have triggered several traffic accidents due to sensor failure last month.
TO HAVE TRIGGERED.exampleZh: 軟體被宣稱在「上個月」引發了事故。

MUST HAVE LACKED.meaning: 當時的訓練資料一定缺乏多樣性
MUST HAVE LACKED.example: The facial recognition system misidentified the suspect; its training data must have lacked diversity.
MUST HAVE LACKED.exampleZh: 系統誤認了嫌犯（過去式），所以推測「當時的訓練資料一定缺乏多樣性」，選 must have + V-p.p.。

HAVE BEEN WARNING.example:
A: Is the new AI tool replacing human writers?
B: Critics have been warning about that possibility, but creativity remains uniquely human.
HAVE BEEN WARNING.exampleZh: 雖然沒有時間副詞，但語意上強調評論家「近期以來一直在警告」這件事，故用現在完成進行式最自然。

TO HAVE COMPELLED.example: The new privacy legislation is widely acknowledged to have compelled tech companies to rewrite their data collection policies.
TO HAVE COMPELLED.exampleZh: 法規被廣泛承認「已經迫使」科技公司重寫政策。

HAS BEEN SPONSORING.example: The marketing agency has been sponsoring social media influencers to boost the new beverage's visibility since June.
HAS BEEN SPONSORING.exampleZh: since June 明確指出動作從六月持續至今，故選現在完成進行式 has been sponsoring。

TO HAVE TARNISHED.example: The controversial advertisement is considered to have tarnished the brand's reputation among younger consumers.
TO HAVE TARNISHED.exampleZh: 這則廣告被認為「已經玷污了」品牌聲譽，破壞的動作已經發生，因此用 to have tarnished。

HAS BEEN REVAMPING.example:
A: Why did they change the logo again?
B: The design team has been revamping the visual identity to appeal to a global audience.
HAS BEEN REVAMPING.exampleZh: 對話表達設計團隊「一直以來都在進行」視覺形象的改造，用現在完成進行式最符合語氣。

TO HAVE GENERATED.example: The viral marketing stunt is estimated to have generated over ten million impressions within the first 24 hours of its release.
TO HAVE GENERATED.exampleZh: 這個行銷噱頭被估計「已經產生了」超過一千萬次曝光，動作已完成，故搭配 to have generated。

SPONSORING GAMERS.example: The concept of sponsoring gamers is fundamental in this context.
SPONSORING GAMERS.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「與電競選手合作」的核心意涵。

HAVE BEEN ASSESSING.example: The board of directors have been assessing potential mergers since the new fiscal year began.
HAVE BEEN ASSESSING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：句尾有 since 加上過去時間點，表示從過去一直持續到現在的動作，且強調持續性，應使用現在完成進行式 (have been V-ing)。

TO BE DRIVEN.example: The unprecedented revenue growth is projected to be driven by a new digital infrastructure.
TO BE DRIVEN.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：project (預計) 後方接不定詞 to V，而營收成長是「被」數位基礎設施所驅動，因此需要用不定詞的被動語態 to be p.p.。

MUST HAVE DISMISSED.example: We secured the dominant market share. Our competitors must have dismissed our aggressive expansion plan.
MUST HAVE DISMISSED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：前句提到「我們取得了主導市佔率（已發生的事實）」，後句推測對手過去一定做錯了什麼決定，表示對過去事實的強烈推測用 must have + p.p.。

TO BE DISTRIBUTED.example:
A: Did the shareholders approve the dividend payout?
B: Yes, a generous dividend is confirmed to be distributed to all investors next month.
TO BE DISTRIBUTED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：confirm 後方如接動作，常見為 is confirmed to V (被確認將會...)。

HAVE BEEN TRACKING.example: Astronomers have been tracking the irregular orbit of the newly discovered exoplanet for several months.
HAVE BEEN TRACKING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：時間標記為 for several months，表示從過去持續到現在的動作，主詞 Astronomers 為複數，故選 have been tracking (現在完成進行式)。

CANNOT HAVE DWELLED.example: The fossil was found in a deep marine rock layer. The creature cannot have dwelled in a shallow sea environment.
CANNOT HAVE DWELLED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：化石是在「深海」岩層中發現的，因此推測該生物「不可能」棲息在淺海環境。

TO HOLD.example:
A: Why are they studying these deep-sea vents?
B: The unique ecosystem there is thought to hold crucial clues about the origins of life on Earth.
TO HOLD.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：is thought 後方接 to V。

HAS BEEN LOSING.example: The research institute has been losing funding for its controversial cloning project since the ethical debate intensified.
HAS BEEN LOSING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：since 連接過去時間 (倫理辯論加劇之時)，主要子句應使用現在完成進行式表示動作持續至今。

HAVE BEEN RALLYING.example: Concerned citizens have been rallying outside the city hall to protest the proposed zoning laws for three consecutive days.
HAVE BEEN RALLYING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：有 for three consecutive days (連續三天) 的時間區段，表示動作從過去持續到現在，應選現在完成進行式 have been rallying。

TO BE TRANSFORMED.example: The historic library in the town center is expected to be transformed into a commercial complex next year.
TO BE TRANSFORMED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：圖書館是「被改建」成商業綜合體，且預期發生在明年 (next year)，is expected 後接不定詞，故選擇 to be transformed (被動)。

MUST HAVE DISREGARDED.example: The mayor approved the demolition of the park. He must have disregarded the immense historical value of that green space.
MUST HAVE DISREGARDED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：市長已經批准了拆除案 (過去式 approved)，所以我們推論他當時「一定忽視了」那片綠地的歷史價值。

TO HAVE EXCEEDED.example:
A: Did you read the editorial about the new stadium?
B: Yes, the construction costs are reported to have exceeded the initial budget by millions of dollars.
TO HAVE EXCEEDED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：are reported 後接 to V，但因為「超出預算」是已經發生的事實，比「被報導」(現在) 更早發生，因此要用完成不定詞 to have exceeded。

TO HAVE VIOLATED.example: The multinational corporation is ruled to have violated antitrust laws by monopolizing the software distribution market.
TO HAVE VIOLATED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：法庭裁決 (is ruled) 是現在式，但公司「違反」反托拉斯法是過去已發生的動作，所以用完成不定詞 to have violated。

MUST HAVE OBTAINED.example: The defendant fled the country hours before the verdict. He must have obtained a tip-off from someone inside the courthouse.
MUST HAVE OBTAINED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：被告在判決前幾個小時逃離國家，所以推論他過去「一定已經獲得」了內部消息。

TO HAVE BEEN DONATED.example: The Renaissance masterpiece is rumored to have been donated to the national museum by an anonymous billionaire.
TO HAVE BEEN DONATED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：畫作是「被」捐贈，且由上下文得知捐贈動作應已發生，因此在 is rumored (被謠傳) 後方使用完成式被動 to have been donated。

MUST HAVE INVESTED.example: The lighting in the exhibition hall is perfectly designed. The curator must have invested a lot of time arranging the spotlights.
MUST HAVE INVESTED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：展廳的燈光設計很完美 (現在的事實)，推論館長過去「一定投入了」許多時間。

TO CAPTURE.example:
A: Did you see the new photography exhibit?
B: Yes, the vintage portraits are considered to capture the essence of post-war society beautifully.
TO CAPTURE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：are considered 後方接 to V。

JAPANESE WOODBLOCK PRINTS.example: The concept of japanese woodblock prints is fundamental in this context.
JAPANESE WOODBLOCK PRINTS.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「繁體中文解說」的核心意涵。

HAS BEEN EXPLORING.meaning: 本題測驗現在完成進行式
HAS BEEN EXPLORING.example: The logistics team has been exploring alternative shipping routes for the past three weeks to avoid the port strike.
HAS BEEN EXPLORING.exampleZh: 本題測驗現在完成進行式，表示從過去持續到現在的動作（for the past three weeks）。

HAS BEEN EXPERIENCING.example:
A: Why is the assembly line stopped?
B: The factory has been experiencing extreme raw material shortages since the new tariff was announced.
HAS BEEN EXPERIENCING.exampleZh: 對話中提到 since，需使用現在完成進行式強調動作的持續性。

TO BE ADOPTED.example:
A: Did the regional manager approve the new contingency plan?
B: Yes, the proposed measures are expected to be adopted formally next Monday.
TO BE ADOPTED.exampleZh: are expected 後接 to V，而措施是被採用的，故用被動 to be adopted。

GLOBAL MICROCHIP SHORTAGE.example: The concept of global microchip shortage is fundamental in this context.
GLOBAL MICROCHIP SHORTAGE.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「global microchip shortage」的核心意涵。

HAVE BEEN STUDYING.example: Nutritionists have been studying the effects of artificial sweeteners on our metabolism for the last decade.
HAVE BEEN STUDYING.exampleZh: for the last decade 搭配現在完成進行式，表示持續至今的動作。
